scope.selection: Distinct active building count per normalized label, ascending by count then alphabetically. Both batches use the identical, unchanged database snapshot.

method: One dedicated sub-agent per amenity type compared saved descriptions, current source pages, related categories and normalization rules. The coordinator reconciled cross-type conflicts. Keep distinct resident functions; merge vague or redundant categories; avoid inferring facilities from nearby public amenities or unrelated commercial businesses. Web listings support advertising, not operational inspections.
reconciliation_notes: Wellness studio is classified as a merge, because all supported facility information is rerouted to existing Gym or Yoga studio categories; it is not an outright loss of facilities.

The Sports court reviewer proposed absorbing Basketball court. This was not adopted: retain the named sport, consistent with the Basketball court review and other specific recreation categories. Correct explicit basketball assignments instead.
Gardening plots becomes Resident gardening rather than Garden, preserving the growing function while avoiding an unsupported promise of assigned plots.
Treatment room remains distinct from ambiguous Spa. Co-location does not by itself erase a function or establish that one facility belongs to another.

Walking trails applies the same property-provided-benefit standard as the first batch’s Lakefront access recommendation. Preserve Kiara’s paths within Shared park, and withhold the unestablished Kirkland Crossing assignment.
application_notes: No database, mapping, building-membership, or historical evidence changes were applied.
Remove means retire the current standalone label and its unsupported assignment, while preserving original evidence and useful benefit/location notes.
A future verified resident Pilates studio or genuine property-provided lake access should be evaluated on its own evidence; these recommendations are based on current assignments.

If approved, update exact source mappings and review decisions, regenerate amenity details and the processing report, preserve source descriptions and unrelated fields, and do not reapply building eligibility.

record_level_followups.finding: Historical 2016 evidence supports the feature, but the current official amenities page does not reconfirm it. Absence from a page is not proof of removal; verify before changing this assignment.
Architect evidence describes the tables, while the current leasing page names only the bar. Verify current availability; retain the category regardless because The Ayer confirms it.
Saved descriptions name HIIT, but current official amenity summaries do not reconfirm it. Verify these assignments; The Ivey supports keeping the category.
Explicit support is from an older official page; refresh the current source. REN and Rainier Square support keeping the category.
Prior official gallery evidence supports cornhole; the current text view did not independently expose the asset. Recheck the image evidence.
Official page was inaccessible during this audit; a current third-party listing corroborates saved evidence. Seek current primary confirmation.
Parking evidence is an older official fee schedule. Verify current EV-designated space availability; do not infer charging.
The current official page confirms a games room but does not name foosball. Recheck this assignment.
Gables evidence differs between the overview and property-specific page. Century Plaza’s page body says Century Place; resolve the identity discrepancy before any record change.
Separate equipment-delivered classes/on-demand content from a resident class program. Where only content access is established, retain it in Gym details instead of a standalone classes assignment.
The current official description names a glass-enclosed courtyard gathering room without reconfirming the pavilion term. Verify before changing the assignment.

Current official descriptions establish basketball use. Review replacement with Basketball court for the same facility; avoid adding a duplicate general label. Keep unspecified courts at Quartz Creek, Terrace Station and The Waverly under Sports court.
